caption: A spoon stands in a clear glass jar of oil and looks kinked where it enters the oil; when it is lifted out the kink vanishes.

sa.check: A spoon stands in a clear glass jar of oil.
It looks kinked where it enters the oil.
The lift comes first and the kink vanishes with it.

pc.expect: The kink sits at the surface of the oil and vanishes when the spoon is lifted out.
pc.fail: The kink is above or below the surface; or it stays when the spoon is out; or the spoon looks straight in the oil.

pc.expect: The spoon is straight and rigid; the kink is an appearance.
pc.fail: The spoon is physically bent when out; or the kink stays at a fixed point on the spoon as it is raised; or the spoon flexes.

pc.expect: The oil surface is level and the jar rigid.
pc.fail: The oil tilts and holds; or the jar warps; or the oil goes opaque.

pc.expect: The spoon moves only with the hand.
pc.fail: It rises by itself; or slides; or jumps.
The spoon duplicates; or the jar vanishes; or the spoon passes through the jar.

pc.expect: The spoon, the oil's colour and the jar stay the same.
pc.fail: The spoon changes colour; or the oil changes colour; or the jar changes shape.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
